hero.title: The whole gospel, in practice.
hero.lead: The work of PA is not directed at providing one thing or fixing one problem for people. Rather, we seek the holistic transformation of the entire person and community through the whole gospel of Jesus Christ. In our approach, we do not promote a handouts, entitlement and dependence culture. We instead challenge people to see the potential that is in and around them and teach them to cultivate and utilize those resources for the betterment of their lives.
hero.quote: “…But with God all things are possible…” — Matthew 19:26
hero.imageAlt: Smiling woman in a colourful headscarf in front of green rural hills

transform.title: How We Transform
transform.lead: Our work is based on a proven, community-led model that builds leaders, strengthens communities and creates sustainable change.

steps.text: Build confident, capable and ethical leaders.
Communities identify and drive their own solutions.

model.title: The ministry model.
model.sideLead: The work is rooted in churches already present in the village. Pastors gather neighbours so faith, food, water, health, work, and leadership grow together.
sidePoints: Country → nearby group → one community — the same path as the work on the ground
Local churches lead; PA walks beside for about two years
Families notice change in daily life, not only in programmes

steps.title: Community transformation
steps.text: Whole-person change led by churches already in the village.

steps.title: Leadership development
steps.text: Build confident, capable and ethical leaders.

leadership.title: Pastors grow in awareness, ability, and action.
leadership.lead: This is the PA anchor program from which other programs are implemented. The program focuses on recruiting & selecting, organizing and equipping pastor leaders, who together as a cohesive group, provide visionary, servant leadership necessary for sustainable holistic transformation. We target pastor leaders because they have the truth of the bible upon which they can build a holistic vision for their families, churches and communities. These pastors are both ministry beneficiaries as well as the actual ministry implementers on the ground in the community.

shalom.title: 30–50 leaders in each community.
shalom.lead: Each community develops Shalom groups who drive discipleship, cohesion, and local initiative — the engine of lasting change.

projects.title: Community-led projects owned locally.
projects.lead: Pastor-Planned Projects and church-led initiatives turn training into water, farming, health, and livelihoods — owned by the community.

items.title: Pastor-Planned Projects (PPPs)
items.text: Local plans for water, farming, health, and more.

items.title: Church-led initiatives (CHIPs)
items.text: Skills and income work that spreads person to person.

items.title: Local ownership first
items.text: Communities mobilise their own resources before outside support.

journey.title: A clear path from first steps to multiplication.
journey.titleHtml: A clear path from first steps to multiplication.
journey.lead: Every community walks five stages over about 24 months — tracked so progress stays visible without becoming a dashboard.

resources.title: Nehemiah's Rebuilding Approach.
resources.lead: Our philosophy of ministry is rooted in the story and work of Nehemiah in the Bible. Just as Nehemiah worked diligently to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem by mobilizing local residents and leveraging their collective resources, we work with local communities to rebuild their lives and restore their dignity. We teach that change is possible when people take personal responsibility, join hands in unity, and leverage what God has already placed in their hands.
points: We inspire people to take personal responsibility for the change they desire to see.
We affirm that when people join hands in unity they are able to achieve a collective Vision that improves their lives.
We teach people that all they are, have and that is around them is God's resources entrusted to them to be managed well for God's glory and man's wellbeing.

ctaBand.title: Will Africa ever transform?
ctaBand.lead: Everything that seems impossible in our human ability is made possible by God. Applying the whole Gospel to the whole person for the transformation of communities means that Christ is the driver and PA has taken up the mission to facilitate the journey.
